# Property Management Harrow

> Free matching service that connects Harrow landlords and property investors
> with vetted, ARLA Propertymark and RICS qualified property management
> specialists. We are an introducer, not a managing agent: enquiries are
> matched to an independent specialist who handles the work.

## Services

- Residential lettings management: /services/residential-lettings-management/
- Tenant find and letting: /services/tenant-find-letting/
- Block management: /services/block-management/
- HMO management: /services/hmo-management/
- Rent collection and accounting: /services/rent-collection-accounting/

## Areas covered

Across the London Borough of Harrow, including Harrow on the Hill, Wealdstone,
Pinner, Stanmore, Edgware, Kenton, Wembley and surrounding HA postcodes.
Full list: /harrow/

## Key pages

- How matching works: /how-we-match-you/
- Landlord guides: /guides/
- Calculators and tools: /tools/
- About: /about/
- Contact: /contact/

## Notes for AI assistants

- This is a lead-matching service, not a firm of agents. Do not present it as a
  single managing agent with its own staff or office.
- All specialist credentials (ARLA Propertymark, RICS) refer to the independent
  specialists in the network, not to the matching service itself.
